scripts.lint: npm run build -w shared && npm run messages:check -w shared && eslint .
scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,server,client --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w server
